text.en:
Now you say what people do.
Ich wohne hier. = I live here.
Wohne means “live”.
Ich lerne Deutsch. = I am learning German.
Lerne means “learn”. Deutsch means “German”.
One German sentence covers “I learn” and “I am learning”.

title.en: The end of the word follows who

text.en:
Look at the last letters of the word.
Ich wohne hier. = I live here.
Du wohnst hier. = You live here.
Anna wohnt hier. = Anna lives here.
Wir wohnen hier. = We live here.
The start, wohn-, stays the same.
Only the end changes: -e, -st, -t, -en.

Many words work just like wohnen.
Ich kaufe Brot. = I am buying bread.
Du kaufst Milch. = You are buying milk.
Kaufe and kaufst mean “buy”. Brot is “bread”. Milch is “milk”.
Check who it is, then pick the end of the word.
